NIFTY AND SENSEX SURGE 1% AS FOREIGN INFLOWS LIFT SENTIMENT

Nifty and Sensex surged more than 1% on 19 November 2026, ending the session higher. The rise reflected sustained foreign inflows into Indian equities.
Strong foreign buying lifted overall market mood, while auto shares such as Maruti and M&M powered the afternoon rally.
